questions.question: Jesus spoke woes against the scribes and Pharisees. What did He say they did to the kingdom of heaven?

answers.text: Open it only to their friends
Sell a place in it to the rich

questions.question: Jesus said the scribes and Pharisees ignored the weightier matters of the law. What were they?
Jesus compared the scribes and Pharisees to whitewashed tombs. What did He say those tombs are full of inside?
Jesus said He had longed to gather the children of Jerusalem together. What picture did He use?

answers.text: A hen gathering her chicks under her wings
A shepherd carrying lambs in his arms
An eagle carrying its young on its wings
